collection.name: frameActions
collection.doc: 🏗️ Action of one load case on the frame (EN 1990 6.4.3): a point force or moment at a node, or a uniform line load on a bar between two positions along it; the load cases are combined by the EN 1990 rules and every combination is solved on its own.

fields.name: load_case_id
fields.doc: 📋 Id of the load case (permanent, imposed, wind, ...) the action belongs to.

fields.name: target_id
fields.doc: 🎯 Id of the frame node (force, moment) or frame bar (line load) the action acts on.

enum.name: FrameActionKind
enum.doc: 🏗️ Kind of a frame action: point force at a node, point moment at a node or uniform line load on a bar.

fields.name: fx
fields.doc: ➡️ Force [N] along global x at a node, or line load [N/m] along the bar axis.

fields.name: fz
fields.doc: ⬇️ Force [N] along global z at a node, or line load [N/m] transverse to the bar (local z).

fields.name: my
fields.doc: 🔄 Moment [Nm] about the frame plane normal at a node.

fields.name: start_ratio
fields.doc: 📍 Where a line load starts, as a fraction of the bar length from its start node (a multiple of 0.25, the solution grid).

fields.name: end_ratio
fields.doc: 📍 Where a line load ends, as a fraction of the bar length from its start node (a multiple of 0.25, at least the start).
